text: Morning. Did you actually sleep or just lie there
Slept til 7 then the alarm went off at 7:05 lol. So mostly
That's a lot of 7s
Broadband bill came, they've gone up again
Ugh. Can we just switch? I'll look tonight
I'll do the comparison, you do the council tax thing
Rather not do council tax on a late. Not before 2pm anyway
Deal
Cabin listing in st ives is still up. The one with the wood burner
[link: the cabin listing]
The one with the bath that faces the sea?? Yes. Dates? We said march
14th to 18th march has space. They want a deposit by friday
Put it on the card, we'll sort it after
Heading in. Dont let the cat eat the rest of the chicken

We don't have a cat
I'll guard the chicken
Deposit's in. Confirmation email in your inbox
Thank you. Sorting it
How's the ward
Quiet so far. One fall in bay 3 but he's fine. Handover's at 22:30 so it'll be late
Long day
Bed's cold without you lol
You'll be fine
I'm not, obviously
[photo: me on the sofa in my old grey jumper, bill spreadsheet open on the laptop]
😂 that's the bill spreadsheet face
[photo: my scrubs top, lanyard, the hospital cardigan I've had on since 6am]
Bit of a downgrade from the grey jumper
You're in a 12 hour cardigan, I'm in a jumper with a hole in it
Still better than mine, it smells of the ward
Ok that's less appealing
Can you get the handover done quicker so you're home sooner
No. I'll be out by midnight if the 2 o'clock arrival doesn't come in
Ok. Ring me when you're on the bus
On the bus. It's empty. Home by 1
Ok. Door's on the latch
Or the chain's off, whichever
In. Chain was on, you absolute muppet
The chain is the problem
Awake. Bed was very warm, thank you
You're welcome. I'm at work. Had a near miss this morning, nothing went out
Nearly swapped amlodipine for amitriptyline. Same packet, different shelf. Caught it at the final check
Oh god. Is the patient ok
Yeah. Never left the building. Still had to fill in the form and ring the GP and I've been a bit shaky since
That's allowed. You caught it, that's the system working
Yeah
Did you tell someone
Dan. Did the incident form. He was nice about it which made it worse lol
Eat something. Not the chicken
Not hungry 🙃
Going to be late, have to do the audit thing for the near miss. Back about 8
Ok. I'm on the sofa in the cardigan. Don't rush
Not the cardigan
Obviously the cardigan
Leaving now. Want anything from the shop
Milk and the good biscuits. Not the value ones
Ok
Up. Early shift, 7 til 3. Did you sleep
Better than wed. Not much
Going in at 8:30. Dan says the audit's at 10 if I want to sit in
You don't have to be the one who sits in
I know
Did you eat the rest of the biscuits
No. Milk's in the fridge. Two biscuits left in the tin
The good ones
Did you ever ring the broadband lot
Not yet. Off at 3, I'll do it on the bus. Or you do it
Did the comparison already. Cheapest is 9 quid less but it's 18 months
Looks like there's a catch
There's always a catch. Send it over, I'll read it when I'm not wrangling a commode
[screenshot: broadband deals, three columns]
Ok. I'd take the middle one but read the small print on the speed. They always do the "up to"
Did that. Middle one's the one
Off. Standing at the bus stop like a lemon. Bus is late like always
Shop's open till 8 if we need anything. Milk's fine for tomorrow
We need the good biscuits again apparently
How's the form. Did Dan close it
Closed. Pharmacy manager wants a chat Monday. Just a chat he says
Is that the bad kind of chat
Dunno. He was nice again. I'd rather he shouted
Nobody shouts at pharmacists. Shouting is for us
Still, you're allowed to feel rubbish about it. You're allowed to say so to him too
Yeah. I'll see
Did you ever sort the cabin thing with the card
Not yet. Will do tonight if I'm awake. Tuesday maybe
Tuesday's fine
Leaving now
Ok. Door's on the latch
Chain's on. I'll ring from the step
